fields.name: asin
fields.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN), multiple ASINs separated by English commas, up to 5, max length 300 characters. Example: B0088PUEPK or B0088PUEPK,B00U26V4VQ,B07M68S376

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Amazon domain ID. Options: 1 (United States), 2 (United Kingdom), 3 (Germany), 4 (France), 5 (Japan), 6 (Canada), 8 (Italy), 9 (Spain), 10 (India), 11 (Mexico), 12 (Brazil)

fields.name: history
fields.description: Whether to include historical data and historical sales in the response. 1 = include price history, sales rank, historical sales and other time-series data (sales for previous months), 0 = return only basic product information. Default: 0
